metal:clean_dry.preparation: Keep clean and dry; check for sharp edges.
metal:clean_dry.disposal: Confirm local metal acceptance before setting it out.
metal:clean_dry.safety_warning: Keep batteries and unsafe parts separate.

metal:contaminated_wet.preparation: Separate; let dry only if safe.
metal:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not offer while wet or contaminated.
metal:contaminated_wet.safety_warning: Avoid unknown residues and sharp edges.

metal:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle or offer unsafe metal.
metal:broken_unsafe.disposal: Ask a local service about safe disposal.
metal:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep away from people and children.

metal:unknown.disposal: Confirm item type and local acceptance.
metal:unknown.safety_warning: Do not handle sharp or contaminated items.

trash:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not place sharp waste loose in a bag.
trash:broken_unsafe.disposal: Ask the local authority about safe disposal.
trash:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep away from people and children.

trash:unknown.safety_warning: Do not handle unknown hazardous contents.

glass:clean_dry.preparation: Empty, rinse if safe, and keep intact and dry.
glass:clean_dry.disposal: Confirm local acceptance for this glass type.

glass:contaminated_wet.preparation: Rinse only if safe, then dry and keep intact.
glass:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not offer while contaminated; confirm local rules.

glass:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle or place broken glass in pickup.
glass:broken_unsafe.disposal: Follow local guidance for safe broken-glass disposal.
glass:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Broken glass can cause serious cuts.

glass:unknown.preparation: Check whether it is intact; keep separate.
glass:unknown.disposal: Confirm material type and local acceptance.
glass:unknown.safety_warning: Do not handle chipped or broken glass.

paper:clean_dry.preparation: Keep clean and dry; remove food and non-paper parts if practical.
paper:clean_dry.disposal: May be accepted under general Perak guidance; check local rules.

paper:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not offer as recyclable while wet or contaminated.

paper:broken_unsafe.preparation: Remove unsafe attachments only if safe.
paper:broken_unsafe.disposal: Keep separate and ask about unusual contamination.

paper:unknown.preparation: Check that paper is clean and dry.
paper:unknown.disposal: Confirm local acceptance for coated or laminated paper.

cardboard:clean_dry.preparation: Flatten; keep dry and remove food residue where practical.
cardboard:clean_dry.disposal: May be accepted under general Perak guidance; check local rules.

cardboard:contaminated_wet.preparation: Separate wet, oily, or food-soiled cardboard.
cardboard:contaminated_wet.disposal: Do not offer as recyclable while contaminated.

cardboard:broken_unsafe.preparation: Remove unsafe attachments only if safe.
cardboard:broken_unsafe.disposal: Ask about contaminated or unusual cardboard.

cardboard:unknown.preparation: Check that it is clean and dry; flatten if practical.
cardboard:unknown.disposal: Confirm local acceptance for coated board.

plastic:clean_dry.preparation: Empty, rinse if safe, and dry.
plastic:clean_dry.disposal: Acceptance depends on item type; confirm local rules.
plastic:clean_dry.safety_warning: Do not include chemical containers unless permitted.

plastic:contaminated_wet.preparation: Separate from clean recyclables; rinse only if safe.

plastic:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle sharp plastic pieces.
plastic:broken_unsafe.disposal: Ask the local provider about safe disposal.
plastic:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep fragments away from people and children.

plastic:unknown.preparation: Identify the item; empty and dry only if safe.

biological:clean_dry.disposal: Use local organics or residual-waste service.

biological:contaminated_wet.disposal: Follow local organics or residual-waste guidance.

biological:broken_unsafe.preparation: Do not handle unsafe biological material.
biological:broken_unsafe.safety_warning: Keep away from people and children.

biological:unknown.disposal: Confirm the local organics or residual-waste route.

hazard:batteries.preparation: Keep batteries separate; cover terminals only if safe.
hazard:batteries.disposal: Never place batteries in community pickup; use an approved collection point.
hazard:batteries.safety_warning: Damaged batteries can heat, leak, or ignite.

hazard:bulbs.preparation: Keep intact and separate; do not dismantle.
hazard:bulbs.disposal: Use a local bulb or hazardous-waste collection route.
hazard:bulbs.safety_warning: Broken bulbs may contain sharp or hazardous components.

hazard:e_waste.disposal: Use an approved local e-waste collection point.
hazard:e_waste.safety_warning: Remove batteries only when safe per device instructions.

hazard:chemicals.preparation: Keep in original labelled container; do not mix or transfer.
hazard:chemicals.disposal: Contact the local authority or hazardous-waste service.
hazard:chemicals.safety_warning: Do not put chemicals in pickup or drains.

hazard:sharp_objects.disposal: Ask the local authority about safe sharps disposal.

hazard:other_hazards.preparation: Keep isolated; do not handle unknown hazards.
hazard:other_hazards.safety_warning: Do not place unknown hazards in pickup.

hazard_confirmation.preparation: Keep hazards separate from items offered for pickup.
hazard_confirmation.disposal: Continue only after confirming hazards are removed.
hazard_confirmation.safety_warning: General safety guidance only; not an emergency response or legal determination.

fallback.preparation: Keep clean, dry, and separate until the material and condition are clear.
fallback.disposal: Confirm acceptance with your local collection provider.
fallback.safety_warning: Do not offer broken, sharp, contaminated, or hazardous items.
